content.short: Syndr is the world's first cross-margined options and futures exchange on Arbitrum.
content.description: Syndr is an institutional-grade decentralized exchange for trading derivatives. Traders can trade options, perpetual contracts and futures on the same platform with high performance and high capital efficiency. Notable features include a high-performance order book with low latency; cross-margin and portfolio margin; everything USD-margined; native block trading; and a best-in-class user experience with one-click deposits and withdrawals, no gas fees for trading, fiat onramps, and a smooth UI for both retail and professional traders. As an institutional-grade platform, Syndr can be integrated with institutional liquidity networks and trading tools such as automated RFQs, option and futures analytics platforms, platforms offering audit trails, directories of potential counterparties with selective KYC/AML, and compliance providers. It is non-custodial by design, so users retain control of their funds. Structured products are planned to be offered, segregated by risk profiles and settled on the exchange.
